thread:
Maya R: prototyping a slim model preview for catalog rows. shows primary perf badge + version selector on hover. aiming minimal visual noise. link: https://figma.redwood/slim-preview
Evan: looks clean. two quick asks: 1) keyboard discoverability (Tab to open?), 2) collapse secondary badges behind chevron to reduce clutter.
Tom: agree on chevron. also avoid layout shift - overlay preferred (absolute + transform).
Sam (a11y): accessibility nits: hover-only previews mustn't steal focus. use aria-live polite to announce short summary. if user explicitly opens preview (Enter/Space) move focus into the overlay. ensure each badge has aria-label like "Typical latency (p50): 82 ms". debounce announcements (~500ms).
Maya R: plan: hover = aria-live announce; Enter = persistent overlay tabbable with small "Add to compare" checkbox. Esc closes overlay and returns focus to row. I'll update figma and copy (change tooltip to "Typical latency (p50)").
Evan: will draft microcopy and badge priority list.
Tom: engineering note: will implement overlay + debounce and avoid reflow. PR when ready.
Sam (a11y): I'll run NVDA/VoiceOver tests on the deploy preview.
